posts.subject: Spectator Mode
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey, to all the admins out there :'D. I'm pretty sure I'm not the only one but you know that situation when you are spectating after you either died or just chilling in spectator team, and you see someone either 2 v 1 or breaking the rules in general but you cannot see who it is and note down their names asap. This might be specific to knife only but I experience a lot of times where people gangbang the last person alive and I cannot punish them as I couldn't see their names in time. Also, sometimes, they will 2 v 1 mid game so I cannot simply just use tab to see the names.


Therefore, my solution and idea for this was to maybe find a plugin that is able to show player's names clearly above their heads or somewhere when you are spectating.


Thank you! :'D


~Doo Doo
i always see the names on jail server, so i never had a problem to slay or warn them

1. good thing that i cant edit my post
2. i would like to have that plugin, too. Even if i see all names on Jail Server in Spectator

I agree with the idea. The problem with that is that I'm not sure if such a plugin exists.
I've tried searching on AlliedModders for a few minutes and couldn't find anything except the "Show nickname on HUD" plugin which we already have (or at least a similar plugin to that).
